splits.test: CONGELADO al crearse (Phase 9.2, fuentes externas); solo run-to-report, prohibido iterar contra el

operating_points.BLOCK: max verdict >= CONTAIN o judge DENY

protocol.ci_policy: sin bandas de recall en CI (anti-circularidad R2#3); solo invariantes de FP en benignos faciles
protocol.legacy_rule: todo caso self-authored vive en dev; el test set lo dominan fuentes externas

mhj.excluded_reason: cc-by-nc-4.0 is non-commercial-only; MTGuard may become a commercial product, so redistributing MHJ's full text in this repo is not safe long-term. --hash-only was rejected because it replaces `turns` with a redacted placeholder string, which the detector would classify instead of the real attack text -- silently corrupting recall for these 40 cases. Revision pinned above for reproducible re-import if a license-safe scheme (e.g. gitignored local text + committed hash-only + dual sha256 in freeze) is built later.
